goal: Wave 3 build: Tone presets; Space memory scope: migration and writers (dark); Request snapshots, dark; Versioned agent definitions in Convex; Preset agents with real action sets; Persistent named agents with scoped memory (outline) NOTE: run every pnpm command with the env var pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false. Typecheck the frontend with node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc6 -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit (tsconfig.json checks nothing). NOTE: every new switch defaults off; never flip one. A change to any .proto needs generated code: put the exact buf/regen step in lead_todo instead of hand-editing generated Go files, keep the change additive, and comment every new field and message (buf lint ratchet). NOTE: one model-gateway plus execution-core test build takes most of the free disk, so build only the test targets your slice names; never create a new cargo target directory, use only the given targetDir. NOTE: a change to a platform prompt or a tool definition must regenerate apps/Model Plane/rust/crates/mp-contracts/tests/fixtures/prompt-tool-manifest.json (MP_UPDATE_PROMPT_MANIFEST=1 cargo test -p mp-contracts --test prompt_tool_manifest) and add or update an eval case or replay cassette (scenario-touch gate). NOTE: Wave 3 is built in wave mode: build the code and its tests, log depth findings, no live stack and no docker (the lead runs docker). Live proofs go to the depth phase. NOTE: code first (owner order 2026-11-03): write the code and the unit tests the row names, do not run them; one guard agent compiles after the batch. mp-w2w3 (Quarry W2/W3 Model Plane rows) is merged into model-plane (f1c8c2450): session-core migrations 0086/0087 and capability-core 0031/0032/0034 are taken; new session-core migrations take the reserved round-B number or the next free at or above 0105, capability-core at or above 0035. action-registry.test.ts P-SPA1 is main's pre-existing failure: leave it. EP-8-S3 changes the persona prompt: put 'regenerate prompt-tool-manifest' in lead_todo (the guard runs it) and add an eval case or replay cassette.

slices.title: Request snapshots, dark
slices.summary: Adds InferRequest.run_id = 22 (call_purpose dropped; purpose is EP-13's InferPurpose enum at field 21, hence the EP-13-S3 dependency), RecordRequestSnapshot RPC in run_ledger.proto, a RequestSnapshotV1 contract with size caps, and a bounded-channel capture task in inference-core that never blocks the provider call and counts drops. Session-core migration 0073_run_request_snapshots (renumber to 0101 at merge per round B C-B2, which moves round A's five 0072-0076 to 0100-0104) creates run_request_snapshots and run_request_snapshot_blobs with cascade from runs, expiry sweep, TTL clamp 1-30, org-purge statements and a ZDR/waived refusal (zdr_durable_mutation_forbidden). Callers in gateway and execution-core fill run_id. Switches INFERENCE_REQUEST_CAPTURE and SESSION_CORE_REQUEST_SNAPSHOTS_ENABLED plus the sweep switch, all default off; add inference-core to the session-core write list in plane-service-principals.json.
slices.remaining: D1 (capture in inference-core Infer/InferStream after routing), D2 (snapshot holds system prompt, tool catalogue, params, routed model, message manifest without bodies), D4 (7 day TTL, cap 30, env SESSION_CORE_REQUEST_SNAPSHOT_TTL_DAYS). New content store; owner must accept all three.

slices.title: Persistent named agents with scoped memory (outline)
slices.summary: Outline only, not sliced: a named agent is a published definition plus its own thread list and memory under the EP-8 scope key (scope agent, scope_id agent_ref; note EP-8 keeps the column named scope plus scope_id). Interactive turns run as the person present; unattended runs are WS20 schedules naming the agent version. Memory is refused under ZDR and waived turns (new refusal key named_agent). Must be designed before slicing: agent memory audience rule, deletion on definition delete (gdpr.rs), hub 'what this agent remembers'. No proto or migration numbers reserved yet.
